name: What should I consider before choosing a new shower for installation?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider before choosing a new shower for installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before choosing a new shower, consider your budget, the available space in your bathroom, your desired aesthetic, and any accessibility needs. For example, a walk-in shower might be ideal for accessibility but requires sufficient floor space, whereas a standard stall is more compact. It's also important to think about the type of showerhead, water pressure needs, and whether you prefer a pre-fabricated unit or a custom-tiled design, as these choices significantly impact the final outcome.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider budget, space, aesthetic, and accessibility needs when choosing a new shower. These factors determine the best fit for your bathroom and lifestyle.
